title: Saving gives no confirmation
steps: Change the display name to Alice.
expected: The save is confirmed on screen — a toast, or the button briefly disabled.
observed: Nothing visibly changes, so there is no way to tell the save landed.
rationale_quote: I clicked save and nothing happened

title: A second save click looks identical to the first
steps: Change the display name to Alice.
Click the Save button a second time.
expected: The second click is either confirmed or visibly a no-op.
observed: Both clicks look the same, so the only way to check is to click again.
rationale_quote: I clicked save and nothing happened

title: A saved display name survives a tab switch
steps: Change the display name to Alice.
Switch to Appearance and back to General.
expected: The display name still reads Alice.
observed: The display name still reads Alice, but nothing said so at save time.
rationale_quote: I clicked save and nothing happened

edit.title: Saving a display name twice gives no confirmation either time
steps: Change the display name to Alice.
Click the Save button a second time.
